findings.title: Dry-run symlinks can modify real files
findings.description: `verbatimSymlinks: true` preserves links pointing outside the sandbox. For example, an absolute `.claude/rules` directory symlink remains connected to the real directory, where `InstallManifest.installFile()` can write updates and `finish()` can delete stale files during `--dry-run`. Isolate symlink targets or reject escaping links before installing. Add regression tests verifying linked files remain untouched.

findings.title: Native pruning drops worktree containment protection
findings.description: Worktrees now use this pruner instead of the deleted containment-checked `pruneStaleFiles()`. A manifest entry containing `../outside.md` and matching CRC/size causes deletion outside the checkout. A symlinked parent directory similarly redirects deletion. Restore lexical containment, resolved-parent containment, and regular-file checks before deletion, and retain the removed safety tests against the native implementation.
